confidence_notes: I ran 5 web searches: 1 for the RBA rate and 4 for Tainan prices. Restaurant meals and beer are best supported. Numbeo-style figures put an inexpensive meal at about NT$120 and a mid-range meal for two at about NT$800. A second aggregator gave about US$6.55 for a basic meal with a drink, and a third source's US$13 looked like an outlier, so I discounted it. Draft beer is about NT$100 (roughly US$3.2) across aggregators. Coffee is an estimate of NT$100-130 for a cappuccino, with weak direct data. Cocktails are based on a 2024 Taipei Times note of about NT$350-400 per drink at a Tainan bar, adjusted slightly down for a mid-sized city. I found no Tainan wine-by-the-glass price, so wine is a judgment based on beer and Taiwan's relatively high wine prices. NT$ figures were converted at an assumed rate of about NT$31-32 per USD, which I did not look up. All four accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any listings, so those anchors are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tainan is a mid-sized, lower-cost southern Taiwan city with strong domestic tourism. I priced it somewhat below Taipei and close to Kaohsiung and Taichung, using Taiwanese city-level aggregator data and the Taipei and Tainan bar prices I found for drinks.
